correctness.rationale: Complete-reset coupling establishes uniqueness and the exponential backward age gives finiteness of all used moments. Independently, the generator L=VΔ_X+Λ²∂²_ω+r(f(0)−f) gives LV=2Λ²−rV, LQ=2dV−rQ, L(V²)=12Λ²V−rV² and L(QV)=2dV²+2Λ²Q−rQV. Stationarity gives Var(V)=20Λ⁴/r² and Cov(Q,V)=48dΛ⁴/r³. The centered block then has a repeated eigenvalue −r and the coupling Q→2dV, which yields P_t(V−EV)=e^(−rt)(V−EV) and P_t(Q−EQ)=e^(−rt)[Q−EQ+2dt(V−EV)]. This verifies both ordered covariances including t=0, their strict inequality for t>0, the ratio, rate inversion and the unique normalized peak by differentiation of u exp(−u). Linear coordinates each have generator eigenvalue −r and diagonal stationary covariance, giving the variance-matched OU covariance, not equality in law. The frozen script was inspected, not executed; its 321 recorded checks range over nine dimension/parameter cases, with three distinct scale/rate pairs, not nine distinct pairs.

evidence: At free age a and lag t the derivatives of Eq. (21) give reverse free covariance (16/3)Λ⁴a³ and forward (16/3)Λ⁴a³+16Λ⁴ta² per coordinate. Given no reset, average these using A~Exp(r) and add the covariance of the conditional means 2Λ² age and 2dΛ² age² at ages A and A+t. The free terms average to 32dΛ⁴/r³ in either order, plus 32dΛ⁴t/r² forward. The age-mean terms give 16dΛ⁴/r³ in either order, plus 8dΛ⁴t/r² forward. A reset in the lag makes the centered covariance contribution zero; multiplying by e^(−rt) gives exactly the frozen formulas.

In the shared-bath proof h=ω²−Eω² and g_j=X_j²−EX_j² have Var(h)=20Λ⁴/r² from its two ω moments, Cov(g_j,h)=48Λ⁴/r³, P_t h=e^(−rt)h and P_t g_j=e^(−rt)(g_j+2th) from the displayed generator block. Pairing with the opposite observable gives the two formulas directly.
